about: Goede, DeBoest & Cross names 27 people across four offices, and its practice leads with community association law, which in Collier County is most of what a real estate lawyer does: estoppel certificates, reserve studies and the disputes that follow them.
On ten pages it publishes no fee terms we could record, no escrow arrangement and none of the stages of a purchase. 48 reviews at 4.45.
